message: 咲良リサイタル

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun, about these documents」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Oh, these are--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~」
The Student Council room after school.
Attendance today is optional. Each of us is wrapping up leftover work at our own pace.
Even though there's no meeting about the Holy Night Festival, Misa opened up the Student Council room just like always.

name: Synn
message: 「You really are dutiful, aren't you」

name: Misa
message: 「Right back at you, Sakura-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What was that exchange just now? Acting like we totally understand each other...」

name: Misa
message: 「It was a coincidence! I haven't accepted you at all!」

name: Misa
message: 「I was... I-I was, right! I was deep in thought about meat buns. I wasn't thinking about the Student Council or the Holy Night Festival even a tiny bit!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, yes it is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, why meat buns all of a sudden?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Means she was so flustered she blurted out a totally unrelated word」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz... Hueh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uh-oh, you went and said the name of food, so she woke right up」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff, sniff, sniff... The smell of sweets is getting closer」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be Misa-senpai? That's strange, Sister isn't here today」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's Nanaka? Wouldn't that be the logical guess?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shut up. I was just throwing a guess out there」

name: Sally
message: 「Heya! I came to hang out, Prez」

name: Paqy
message: 「Both of those are misses, y'know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, I brought beef bowl coupons as a souvenir~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff-sniff, snuffle-snuffle」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahyahahahaha! Roro-chi's sniffing me all over, it tickles~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How could this be」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though you are Miss Bonus, you don't have the main sweets with you. How negligent!」

name: Sally
message: 「I-I'm sorry... wait, huh? Why am I getting scolded?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawah!? Sniff-sniff-sniff, I was fooled by Miss Bonus. The scent of sweets is still rapidly approaching」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good work, everyone! Sorry I'm late」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff-sniff!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Snuffle-snuffle」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ubyaaah!? What do you two think you're doing, pressing right up against me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Treasurer, you brought sweets as a treat, didn't you? In my estimation, it is sweet bread」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, I got a whole bunch of pretzels from Touka... wait a sec, are you a dog, Roro-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not a doggy, I am an angel」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I knew it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawah, I am not an angel. I am just your run-of-the-mill human!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch, munch, munch ♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! You can have some, just make sure you ask permission before you eat」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I refuse. Nom, nom, nom\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not that kind of 'refuse'!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm saying don't just start stuffing your faces out of nowhere--let's make some tea and eat them together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No sneaking bites! Pretzels for the two of you are temporarily confiscated!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaaah~~!? G-Grrr! Woof woof woof, grrrrrrr!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awoo, awoo, woof woof woof!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Now there are two dogs」

name: Misa
message: 「Here, I'm almost done brewing everyone's tea」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, thanks, grumpy Misa-Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude. I can smile properly too!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right, Sally-chan. Misa's smiling face is very lovely」

name: Misa
message: 「Nnah!? Wh-wh-wh-what are you saying, Sakura-kun!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gulp…… haah~. The black tea brewed by the Vice President is exquisite」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you know? Even over-steeped tea leaves have a connoisseur's wabi-sabi to them」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They do not」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Misa, you forgot to brew a cup for one person」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, I'm fine. I have choir practice starting soon」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that so? Sorry for making you brew tea when you're busy」

name: Misa
message: 「It's fine, doing this calms my mind. Thanks to that, I feel like I'll be able to sing with a good voice」

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, excuse me for leaving first」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, good work--」

name: Synn
message: 「Have a good practice」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm off」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Munch munch munch♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom, nom, nom\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gulp...」

name: Sally
message: 「Glug, glug, glug」

name: Synn
message: 「You two are eating way too much. Let's save some for Misa too, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why? Misa didn't say she was coming back, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「W-well, yeah, that's true, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking of going to observe the choir. While I'm there, I can hand over the pretzels too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Even though you've never had any interest in hymns, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, they're going to sing at the Holy Night Festival, aren't they? As Student Council President, I need to check in on how the choir is doing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't have to do that today, though」

name: Synn
message: 「If I don't do what I can today, things will just get sloppy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-don't you have some kind of meeting with Lolo-chan and Sally-chan--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~」

name: Sally
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-these girls...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Eat, then sleep! Man, I wanna live like them too」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright then, I'm heading over to the church」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm coming too! As the Student Council treasurer! That's fine, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「I never said you couldn't come in the first place, did I?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-right, you didn't. Tehee」

name: Synn
message: 「Why'd you go quiet, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haha, hahahahaha... Can I ask you one thing? Synn, could it be that you've got a thing for Misa?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, uh, let's see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, since Shio-chan is an exorcist shrine maiden of 'Ki', Misa might have 'Ki' too, seeing as she's related to the Asukai family」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that half-baked evasion! Whenever I asked you this kind of question before, you always flat-out denied it!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the one acting weird, Nanaka. Getting mad over something like this is a first for you. What's gotten into you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing's gotten into me! And it's not a first either!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've always been like this since way back when, today's just the first time I'm getting all huffy about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're contradicting yourself because you're mad, aren't you? That's why I'm always nagging you to drink your milk...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not a calcium deficiency!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Synn-dono and Nanaka-dono. Where might the two of you be headed together?」

name: Synn
message: 「We're going to the church to see the choir」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, what a coincidence. As am I」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, that's unexpected」

name: Shio
message: 「I was influenced by my elder sister, you see」

name: Shio
message: 「When feeling down or lost on the path one should take... listening to the choir's singing calms the heart and makes for a splendid change of pace」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right? Let's hurry up and get going then, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, you culprit」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you saying I even did?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm so ticked off! I'm as super-duper ticked off as when I realize the decorations on sweets aren't edible!」

name: Shio
message: 「What did you say!? To think she is in such a towering rage!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get that comparison, though...」

name: Shio
message: 「There is no time to explain! Let us convey Nanaka-dono to the church at once!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright, you're on, Nanaka. Let's race to see who gets to the church first」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat, a race?! Don't go mistaking me for someone else!」
While soothing an angry Nanaka, we head to the church--

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Listening to the hymns put Paqy right to sleep.」

name: Shio
message: 「What a peaceful sleeping face. It is no wonder.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It really did calm me down. Staying mad is starting to feel silly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I don't know what happened, but just forget about trivial stuff like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not trivial at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-She's mad again...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting.」

name: Misa
message: 「I never expected everyone to come listen.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing you need to thank us for.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, thanks to you all, the choir kids had just the right amount of nerves and sang better than usual.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Here you go, Misa.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz...」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're giving me Paqy? I'll gladly accept!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Sister, even for a misunderstanding, that is stretching things a bit far...」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, I'm only joking. You brought sweets, didn't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「If you had emailed me, I would have gone back to the Student Council room to get them.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still... *munch, munch, munch*」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sister!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, why are you so surprised?」

name: Shio
message: 「This is the first time I have ever seen Sister eating while standing.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's fine every once in a while! I sang a lot, so I'm hungry. *Munch, munch, munch*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, sorry I didn't think of that! I should've brought some black tea in a thermos.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, they're delicious just as they are」

name: Misa
message: 「Everyone, eat up too. It's more delicious that way, and they do say there's good fortune in leftovers, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, these are sweets left over from Chocolat l'Or, and then left over again in the Student Council room. They must be packed full of happiness and good luck.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't make 'em sound like table scraps! Pretzels were originally made from leftovers, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Back in the day, churches used to make bread and wine, and it all started when a priest made a treat out of the leftover bread dough, I'm telling ya」

name: Shio
message: 「You are quite knowledgeable, Lady Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it comes to sweets, just leave it to me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chomp, chomp, nom, nom. Huaa~ So this is the taste of good fortune, is it? Though I can't really tell the difference」

name: Synn
message: 「...Lolotte, why are you here?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Listen to this, Mr. President! Miss Omake is fast asleep snoring away in the Student Council room. She really is hopeless」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, no? Munch, munch, munch」
Chatting happily together, everyone polishes off the pretzels.

name: Shio
message: 「I have made a new discovery」

name: Shio
message: 「Eating sweets together after listening to a hymn soothes the soul even more than usual」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, I can't really put it into words either, but it feels really nice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's weird... Even when I listen to hymns on CD or TV, it never feels like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's because we got to hear her singing voice live?」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, even if you flatter me, I'm not going to give you anything!」

name: Shio
message: 「So close... Sir Synn, that is a remarkably close deduction」

name: Shio
message: 「The true answer is precisely because it was my elder sister, you see?」

name: Shio
message: 「My sister has submitted numerous poems to magazines and received high praise from various esteemed teachers」

name: Shio
message: 「Putting heartfelt emotion into lyrics while singing is an effortless feat for her」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--waa--waaaah! Shio, don't go blabbing unnecessary things!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun and Nanaka-san, forget what you just heard right now!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why? I think it's amazing. Nothing to be embarrassed about」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa submitting poetry? Oh, I get it, salaryman senryu, right」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! Just what kind of girl do you think I am, Sakura-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, to me, Misa is--」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't say it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey Synn, what about me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Soba」

name: Synn
message: 「S-She hit me. With a fist...」

name: Shio
message: 「That is only natural」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, I'm jealous of the relationship between you and Nanaka-san, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Your relationship with Shio-chan is wonderful too, Misa. You two are sisters, master and disciple, and best friends, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not what she means. Just how dense can this guy get」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, I get that Misa has a really pretty singing voice」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to try singing too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, there's no way you can do it, Synn」

name: Misa
message: 「That's true... Though if I could sing with a boy, it would make the ideal tone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Misa...? You're not actually serious, are you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun wishes for it, after all. Having the drive to improve oneself is a wonderful thing」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, hmm... Even if we can play the melody, the lyrics are difficult」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, hymns do have a stiff image」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H―Hey, Synn! Misa's the captain, so talking like that is―」

name: Misa
message: 「No, it's a valuable opinion」

name: Misa
message: 「For our―for everyone's true selves, I want to make it a song that not just Sally―san of the demons, but all kinds of people can sing across races」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, I'll try singing it by ear as a total amateur, picturing Misa while I do」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, let me hear it. I'll use it as a reference」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem…… 」

name: Synn
message: 「Hogeh～～～♪　Boeh～～～♪」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude!　I didn't sing anything like that!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Whoa…… Despite excelling in academics, it seems true that heaven does not grant two gifts to one person」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already knew, but to think it had gotten this bad…… 」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hogeeh～～～♪　Boeh～～～♪」

name: Misa
message: 「You too, Lolotte, don't imitate it while looking so happy!!」
